svg.title: The gate a model pipeline is missing
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “The gate a model pipeline is missing” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A nine-gate CI pipeline drawn left to right with each gate's duration underneath and a dashed parallel track carrying two concurrent jobs that rejoin before deploy, cutting the critical path from 4m42s to 3m03s; the fourth gate is drawn heavier and circled as a model quality check, shown twice as a tilting balance comparing a committed baseline of 0.938 against builds of 0.931, which passes, and 0.918, which fails, plus a crossed-out long-lived secret replaced by OIDC and a rollback arrow to a previous image digest.
